name: mrmunch_menu_contribution_ingest
description: Atlas Stream Processing: when a user contributes a menu, fan out into dishes for shared knowledge. Create this in Atlas → Stream Processing → create instance → create processor.
notes: Requires Atlas Stream Processing workspace (not available on every free tier).
Alternative on M0: use api/menus/contribute + direct upsert into dishes (already in app code).
Stream Processing shines when you later add Kafka / change-data-capture from scrapers.
